title: Origin story: Xandriel
description: Xandriel was a mapmaker who grew obsessed with the roads not taken, and began mapping them: the city as it would be if the river had turned, the life as it would be if the letter had been sent. His atlas of maybe is the most dangerous book in the world — read it, and you might walk into a better life, or a worse one.
